review: Require the declared independent each binding, narrow the decision record contract, and replace learned reconnection with deterministic lookup.

command.text: Explicit implementation revision retaining all accepted requirements, operations, real visits, workbook writing and cleanup. The revised composition is still not ready: it creates workflow foreach plus one mapping per page, forwards href/reference/actions in broad view records to interpretation, and describes learned resolve transforms as deterministic instead of using lookup. Use the existing TaskPlan transform declaration precisely: kind=transform, mode=extract, each={input:"pages",output:"views"}, inputs=[pages bound to the full authoritative observationSnapshot.pages], resultType object with the sole field views of type array<array<closed fact record>>. This is one independent mapping invocation over every complete page, not a workflow foreach that restarts mapping generation for each page. The inner fact record contains only reference (observed candidate identity), kind, tag, role (nullable) and text needed for the immediate blocking/control/product decision. Do not include href, selectors, actions, complete records, broad page envelopes or redundant pageOrder in the interpretation view. Use the actual observed reference as identity; do not invent id/localOrder fields or indices inside learned extraction. Extract only observed facts relevant to that declared immediate decision, preserving source coverage; [] for a page is only a checked absence. Keep all original records separately. A pure typed foreach over pages exporting each page.records, followed by explicit one-level flatten, can form the authoritative record list with no learned mapping. Original records already have producer-held unique references. Global interpretation returns selected references as arrays of string IDs, including empty arrays for no optional action. The existing typed value binding lookup, port:"reference", items:[originalRecords,selectedIds] reconnects these to exact original records. Replace resolve_home_targets, resolve_search_target and resolve_top_product_links learned transforms with this actual deterministic lookup and typed values/conditions. Use ordinary bounded business loops over selected records for clicks/fill/navigation; producer action compatibility and all existing runtime guards remain effective. Preserve separate original completeness metadata guards. Apply the same transform.each page extraction before product interpretation, and bind only necessary product context rather than the whole selected source record. Keep global decisions global over all compact facts. Preserve the max-ten selection, per-product visits, exact writer destination, and cleanup. No full snapshots in global inputs, no increased limits, no reset budgets, no inferred defaults or fabricated observations. An explicit global implementation revision is authorized for these intermediate data bindings; accepted business intent is unchanged.
